text: somebody at the Goodwill will love finding a knife in its original box and brand .... These are lovely people in the company...they accepted my request for a return very promptly and no questions asked...then I just forgot to mail it to them and the time elapsed...oh well, somebody at the Goodwill will love finding a knife in its original box and brand new....the knife is ok.  I tested it on a few veggies and it was a fantastic sharp knife...it is pretty to look at and the folks at Maranc are lovely as well, hence the three stars.
